strongest_new_result.threshold: Full-permutation endpoint invariance in output cube exists iff eta_c*eta_d<=rho**(N-1)
strongest_new_result.sharpness: Zero-width optimum sharp generally; one independent exact positive-width equality witness. Not every prescribed positive width claimed
